title: Grateful Dead Live at Philadelphia Civic Center on 1984-04-19
source: Master Audience Recorded By Steve Hill, Transfer By Keo; 2 Sennheiser 421's (X-Y Cross) And 2 Nakamichi CM300/CP4 Shotguns (Spread) > Unknown Mixer > Sony D5, Tapes:Maxell UDXLII - 90's; Transfer With Nakamichi MR-1 > Korg MR-1000 @ 1 Bit/5.6 MHz; Tracking/Sample Rate Conversion With AudioGate V.3.0.2 To 32/96 kHz Wave; Dithered/Flacked With Korg Aqua To 16/44; SBE's Checked/Fixed With Trader's Little Helper; Metadata Tagging With Tag&Rename

ai_review.summary: Clean audience recording with excellent sound quality capturing a very good three‑night run.
ai_review.review: The tape was recorded from the 10th row using a Yamaha mixer and combines two tapers’ feeds, resulting in an unusually clear audience source. Reviewers describe all three nights as "very, very good," making this a solid performance despite the lack of specific song highlights.

ai_rating.rationale: Single detailed five‑star review praises both the pristine audience recording and the overall quality of the shows, leading to a high rating but with low confidence due to limited sample size.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Recorded from row 10 on the right side of the aisle using a Yamaha mixer; combines two tapers' feeds, resulting in a clean copy with no dropout issues.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Reviewer notes that all three nights were "very, very good," indicating consistently strong performances throughout the show.
